summary: In community.hrobot, the robot inventory plugin's filters option is no longer an alias of simple_filters and is now a different option.
questions: Did filters change in the Hetzner robot inventory plugin?

answer_card.title: hrobot inventory filters change
answer_card.answer_md: In the `community.hrobot` robot inventory plugin, `filters` is now a separate option and no longer an alias of `simple_filters`. Rename any old `filters` usage to `simple_filters`.
